verdict: AI-generated inference; the referee reports were not available. The accepted version keeps all the data of v1 and answers mainly in words and simulations: the headline claim was softened from 'unveiled' and 'compelling evidence' to 'signatures' and 'support', altermagnetism and bi-altermagnetism were defined, and a new ferrimagnetic-phase simulation (Fig. S9) argues that the m versus m' selection rule, not the mere onset of CD, distinguishes bi-altermagnetism. Experimental details (angles, beam size, polarization degree, flux ratio, normalization, fit constraints) were added to the SI, and the origin of feature A and the 2:3 fit were hedged. The old review anticipated most of these requests (S1, S4, S8, S11, S20, S21, S23), but its strongest experimental asks (domain control, quantified CD with error bars, temperature-dependence plot, incident-energy CD map, second sample) were not met, which suggests referees did not press for new measurements or accepted rebuttals.

inferred_requests.title: Tone down and define the bi-altermagnetism claim
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely said the data do not prove a new form of altermagnetism and asked the authors to define altermagnetism and bi-altermagnetism precisely and to soften 'unveiled' and 'compelling evidence'.

inferred_requests.title: Show the CD distinguishes bi-altermagnetism from other magnetic orders
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked why CD appearing below T_N identifies bi-altermagnetism rather than any magnetic order, for example the nearby ferrimagnetic phase; the authors answered with a selection-rule argument and a ferrimagnetic simulation.

inferred_requests.title: Report the experimental geometry, beam and polarization details and the normalization
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked for incident and scattering angles, beam size, degree of circular polarization, helicity flux balance and how RCP and LCP spectra were normalized.

inferred_requests.title: Justify that feature A is a local Oh spin-orbital excitation
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked whether the low-energy CD could come from magnons, phonons or vibronic modes rather than local Oh J_eff excitations.

inferred_requests.title: Make the two-peak fit and the 2:3 argument robust or hedge them
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely questioned the two-component fit near the elastic line and the 2:3 ratio claim; the authors described the fit constraints and recast it as a minimal decomposition.

inferred_requests.title: Clarify why time reversal does not forbid RIXS-CD
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely found the non-Hermiticity argument unclear and asked for a clearer explanation of why only unitary symmetries constrain RIXS-CD.

inferred_requests.title: Position the work against prior RIXS-CD and XMCD work
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked for prior RIXS-CD work on ferro- and ferrimagnets and other altermagnets, and objected to the claim that XMCD lacks sublattice resolution.

inferred_requests.title: State that spin splitting itself is not measured
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely noted that the hallmark of altermagnetism, momentum-dependent spin splitting, is not probed by local dd excitations.

inferred_requests.title: Explain how the sublattice sites enter the simulation
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked how the up and down sites of each sublattice are treated in the model and why they are not equivalent.

inferred_requests.title: Show sample characterization
inferred_requests.text: A referee may have asked for evidence of sample quality and orientation; a sample photo and Laue pattern were added.

inferred_requests.text: Data deposition may have been requested by a referee or required by the journal.

issue_status.reason: Claim softened and bi-altermagnetism defined; ferrimagnetic selection-rule simulation and partial-cancellation remark added, but no spin-group analysis, per-sublattice CD or observable separating a bi-altermagnet from a polarised second sublattice.
Beam size now given, but domain state, cooling protocol and CD reproducibility across positions or cooldowns are not discussed.
Normalization, polarization degree and flux ratio now stated; still no difference spectra, error bars or quantified CD and m-plane residual.
Magnon, phonon and vibronic origins discussed and fit constraints given; no incident-energy CD map or explicit Td CD at low energy.
Site Hamiltonians described and m-plane and ferrimagnetic simulations shown in Fig. S9; no overlay of measured and convolved calculated CD, and 'quantitatively reproduced' is asserted without it.
No integrated CD versus temperature plot or temperature calibration added.
Weiss field still chosen as a 'reasonable value' of 3-5 meV without independent tie.
Ferrimagnetic CD simulated to differ in selection rules and magnitude, but no M(T), M(H), stoichiometry or XAS-CD for the measured crystal.
Angles now given for m' geometry; the m-geometry Q and azimuth are still not specified and the null is measured once.
Feature C explanation unchanged; no final-state broadening given.

'Zero-order' dropped, ratio recast as spacing and made conditional, fit described as constrained minimal decomposition; no uncertainties, the zeta 52 vs 65 meV split remains, and 'minimal momentum dependence' stays.
Sample photo added but number of crystals, mounts and cooldowns not reported; no second sample.
Ferrimagnetic (field or doping) phase discussed and simulated as a future test; no Zn-substituted measurement.
No momentum or angle dependence of the CD measured; the dipole-operator statement remains, now as 'angle dependence'.
'Rare example ... active orbital magnetism' unchanged.
Angles for both Q values now given; no reason for using two Q values.
SI derivation unchanged, including g = 5/2 and antiparallel orbital moment.
Mirror and glide terminology unchanged.
Paramagnetic simulation still 'not shown'.
Angles, beam size, polarization degree and outgoing-polarization treatment added; no acquisition time or self-absorption statement.
The sentence that XMCD and AHE lack sublattice resolution was removed.
Abstract phrase unchanged, but the introduction now states the defining symmetry relation.
Source data deposited on Zenodo; code still on request.

unaddressed_major.title: Magnetic domain state not characterised or controlled
unaddressed_major.why: Nothing on domains, cooling or reproducibility was added; the only related addition, beam size, came with a general setup section, so referees probably did not press this.

unaddressed_major.title: Temperature dependence of CD not quantified
unaddressed_major.why: Figures 3, S3 and S4 are unchanged and no text was added; a plot would have been cheap from existing data if asked.

unaddressed_major.title: Weiss field chosen after the fact
unaddressed_major.why: The SI wording is identical; the ferrimagnetic simulation reuses 3 meV without further justification.

unaddressed_major.title: Number of samples and reproducibility not reported
unaddressed_major.why: A sample photo and Laue pattern were added, which looks like a partial answer to a sample question, but no second sample appears.

unaddressed_major.title: Model-experiment comparison only qualitative
unaddressed_major.why: Simulation details and Fig. S9 were added, yet no overlay; the authors even strengthened to 'quantitatively reproduced', suggesting they defended the agreement.
